options.name: action
options.description: Work on group or member level

options.name: description
options.description: The group description

options.name: external
options.description: Allow adding external non-IPA members from trusted domains

options.name: externalmember
options.description: List of members of a trusted domain in DOM\name or name@domain form. Requires "server" context.

options.name: gid
options.description: The GID

options.name: group
options.description: List of group names assigned to this group.

options.name: groups
options.description: The list of group dicts (internally gid).

options.name: idoverrideuser
options.description: User ID overrides to add. Requires "server" context.

options.name: ipaadmin_password
options.description: The admin password.

options.name: ipaadmin_principal
options.description: The admin principal.

options.name: ipaapi_context
options.description:
The context in which the module will execute. Executing in a
server context is preferred. If not provided context will be
determined by the execution environment.

options.name: ipaapi_ldap_cache
options.description: Use LDAP cache for IPA connection.

options.name: membermanager_group
options.description: List of member manager groups assigned to this group. Only usable with IPA versions 4.8.4 and up.

options.name: membermanager_user
options.description: List of member manager users assigned to this group. Only usable with IPA versions 4.8.4 and up.

options.name: name
options.description: The group name

options.name: nomembers
options.description: Suppress processing of membership attributes

options.name: nonposix
options.description: Create as a non-POSIX group

options.name: posix
options.description: Create a non-POSIX group or change a non-POSIX to a posix group.

options.name: query_param
options.description: The fields to query with state=query. Can be `ALL`, `BASE`, `PKEY_ONLY` or a list of specific field names.

options.name: rename
options.description: Rename the group object

options.name: service
options.description: List of service names assigned to this group. Only usable with IPA versions 4.7 and up.

options.name: state
options.description: State to ensure

options.name: user
options.description: List of user names assigned to this group.
